complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Produce a refined work-plan for Task 1 that: (a) enumerates every API signature and shared variable; (b) specifies exact C/Fortran binding details including name-mangling rules, volatile semantics and thread safety; (c) designs the binary checkpoint layout, versioning strategy and forward-compatibility policy; (d) drafts a complete test matrix for unit, integration, performance and sanitizer runs; (e) lists all required build-system changes (Make, CMake, CI) with compiler flags; and (f) identifies failure-handling and recovery workflows.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Requires cross-language signalling, asynchronous safety, binary I/O, build adjustments and multi-platform tests; multiple moving parts justify one extra subtask for binary-format and compatibility design.
